hook.line: One of the best ways to grow on TikTok is to use SEO.
hook.visual: Selfie in a parked car, face filling the frame and moving toward the lens, under a white 'How to go viral with SEO !!!' title.

beats.what: Car selfie, fixed white title on top, claim that SEO is a top growth lever.
'SEO (SEARCH ENGINE OPTIMIZATION)' definition text appears as she explains TikTok reads on-screen words.
A pointing-hand emoji next to a pasted screenshot of TikTok's edit menu shows where the captions button is.
She reveals the 'trick nobody tells you': ask ChatGPT for SEO keywords.
The prompt appears as a white text box to screenshot.
The only cut; she continues with why categorized videos get shown to more people.
'Oh and also': paste the keywords and drag them off screen.
Extra uses of ChatGPT: hook, description, hashtags.
Closes with 'use this tip next time you post'.

why_it_works: Promises a 'trick nobody tells you' midway, so viewers stay for the secret.
A copyable prompt on screen gives a concrete takeaway to screenshot.
Casual car selfie with constant talk (4% silence) reads as a friend's tip, not an ad; 497 comments suggest questions it raised.
weaknesses: 140 s with one cut and few graphics; the middle repeats itself.
The prompt, the main payoff, only appears around 64 s.
No explicit CTA beyond 'use this tip'.
for_robert: Avoid the long single take; but borrow the on-screen copyable prompt card, which Fred could hold up as a sign for viewers to screenshot.
